item.title: Oil prices surge after Trump rejects Iran’s plan to reopen Strait of Hormuz
item.description:
Oil prices rose as Washington and Tehran seemed no closer to reaching a durable truce. US President Donald Trump rejected a peace proposal from Iran on Friday; he told Axios he believed talks would resume this week , though The Wall Street Journal reported that he told aides he expects to bomb Iran again after November’s midterms . All the while, the Trump administration has reportedly been issuing ultimatums to Tehran’s trading partners , warning that continued commerce risked US sanctions. Though oil supplies from the Gulf appear to be recovering — September exports from the Middle East were the highest since the war began — overall sales remain well short of pre-conflict levels. Benchmark crude rose more than 2%. — Prashant Rao
